  "workings": "To determine the Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC), we use the formula: WACC = (Debt * Cost of Debt + Equity * Cost of Equity) / (Debt + Equity). Given Debt = Rwf25 million, Cost of Debt = 10%, Equity = Rwf20 million, Cost of Equity = 20%, we calculate WACC tax exempt as (25000000 * 0.10 + 20000000 * 0.20) / (25000000 + 20000000) = 0.144444 or 14.4444%. parsedContent.workings: To determine the Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC), we use the formula: WACC = (Debt * Cost of Debt + Equity * Cost of Equity) / (Debt + Equity). Given Debt = Rwf25 million, Cost of Debt = 10%, Equity = Rwf20 million, Cost of Equity = 20%, we calculate WACC tax exempt as (25000000 * 0.10 + 20000000 * 0.20) / (25000000 + 20000000) = 0.144444 or 14.4444%. With a 30% marginal tax rate, the formula adjusts to WACC = (Debt * Cost of Debt * (1 - Tax Rate) + Equity * Cost of Equity) / (Debt + Equity), thus WACC = (25000000 * 0.10 * (1 - 0.30) + 20000000 * 0.20) / (25000000 + 20000000) = 0.127778 or 12.7778%.
